Trace, implement and test: Search In Rotated Array

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace LeetCode_Arrays
{
    class SearchInRotatedArray
    {
        public int Search(int[] nums, int target)
        {
            if (nums == null || nums.Length == 0)
                return -1;
            var low = 0;
            var high = nums.Length - 1;
            var right = nums[nums.Length - 1];
            int mid;
            while (low <= high)
            {
                mid = (low + high) / 2;
                if (target == nums[mid])
                    return mid;
                if (right > nums[mid])
                {
                    if (target > nums[mid] && target <= right)
                        low = mid + 1;
                    else
                        high = mid - 1;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (target < nums[mid] && nums[0] <= target)
                        high = high - 1;
                    else
                        low = low + 1;
                }
            }
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
